note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for priv/ggen/ash-pplan-durable-tla-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"actions" emits one row per dp:param triple (an action may take several params), so it
is a VALUES contract on dp:param; the action-level required facts (rdfs:label, dp:order,
dp:effect) are named by the companion verify/030_actions.unbound.rq.
"statuses" is anchored on dp:terminal (required conjunct), NOT on rdfs:label -- label
is shared vocabulary across States, Transitions, Actions, Guards and Properties in this
ontology, so a label anchor would count subjects of four other classes too.
